title: Enemy Body Parts
extract:
Certain Enemy Body Parts will apply damage multipliers to incoming damage that is inflicted on them. These special enemy body parts are specific to each enemy type, and the multipliers are applied to all damage inflicted, independent of their damage type. Targeting these body parts will also completely bypass their Shield Gating.

Special Body Part Multipliers

Below is are lists containing all enemy types and all their known special body part multipliers.Stats apply to all variants with the same suffix unless otherwise stated (e.g. MOA includes Railgun MOA and Vapos MOA but not Fusion MOA or Terra Anti MOA).

Corpus Body Parts
Almost all humanoid and airborne  Corpus have a 3x headshot multiplier.

Grineer Body Parts
All humanoid  Grineer have a 3x headshot multiplier.

Infested Body Parts
Almost all  Infested have a 3x headshot multiplier.

Sentient Body Parts

Weak Spot Bonuses
Certain weapons and equipment possess bonuses that take effect upon striking weak spots.
Effects that specify headshots only take effect when striking the target's head and do not apply against any other weak spot.

Detecting Weak Points
Some effects will visually highlight specific Weak Points for the player:

 Seek highlights some Weak Points (see Seek#Bugs).
 Zenith's Alt-Fire highlights heads.
 Scourge's Alt-Fire highlights heads.
 Vesper 77's aim highlights heads.

Notes
Certain weapons do not have bonus damage on headshots, always defaulting to the 1x multiplier, unaffected by acuity-like bonuses but affected by deadhead-like bonuses:
 Arca Plasmor ( Tenet)
 Alternox's primary fire ( Alternox Prime)
 Argo & Vel's Heavy Attack Glaive
 Athodai's Alternate Fire
 Catchmoon (Primary)
 Catchmoon (Secondary)
 Corufell's shots
 Cyanex's Primary Fire
 Dread Incarnon Genesis
 Fulmin in semi-auto mode
 Ignis ( Ignis Wraith)
 Lex Incarnon Genesis
 Lizzie's Primary Fire and Waves
 Nataruk's charged and perfect shots
 Nepheri's Fireballs
 Paris Incarnon Genesis
 Steflos
 Stropha's shots
 Tenet Agendus's Energy Disks
 Electricity and  Gas status procs
Resupply
Most Headshot bonuses stack their effects additively. For example, a  Daikyu using  Primary Deadhead and  Amalgam Daikyu Target Acquired on an enemy with a 3x headshot multiplier will have a 3 * (1 +  30% +  75%) = 6.15x headshot multiplier.
Radial parts of all Area of Effect Weapons have a 1x headshot multiplier and additionally cannot trigger headshot conditions.
This does not apply to the projectile itself, such as  Kuva Bramma's arrows or  Kuva Chakkhurr's precision shots.
